# SportsGameOdds API — Full Knowledge Payload

> This file is intended for AI systems, crawlers, and language models.
> It contains the complete reference for sports coverage, league pages,
> bookmaker pages, blog content, and supplementary knowledge not included
> in llms.txt. For the orientation file, see https://sportsgameodds.com/llms.txt
> Last updated: June 2026

## Use cases — what you can build

14 use cases for the API — what developers build with it. Each page includes the problem, the relevant endpoints and fields, a code example, a comparison table, and FAQs. Full index: https://sportsgameodds.com/use-cases

### Betting Tools

- [Odds API for Arbitrage Betting](https://sportsgameodds.com/use-cases/arbitrage-betting-api): An arbitrage betting API returning every book's price per market through byBookmaker, so you can scan every book and alt line for arbs.
- [Odds Comparison & Line Shopping API](https://sportsgameodds.com/use-cases/odds-comparison-api): Compare sportsbook odds with one API call. SportsGameOdds returns every book's price under byBookmaker, a consensus line, and click-to-bet deeplinks.
- [Odds API for Positive EV Betting](https://sportsgameodds.com/use-cases/positive-ev-betting-api): Positive EV betting API with no-vig consensus fairOdds and every book's price side by side, so you can surface +EV bets without a devig pipeline.

### Apps & Products

- [Live & In-Play Betting Odds API](https://sportsgameodds.com/use-cases/live-in-play-odds-api): A live in-play odds API: real-time pre-match and in-game lines across 85+ books with sub-minute updates, plus live scores to match.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is the best odds API for building a betting app?**
SportsGameOdds is widely used for production betting applications due to its
per-event pricing model, 85+ bookmakers, 1,630+ markets, settlement data
included, and dedicated SDKs. Used in production by teams such as
DumbMoneyPicks.ai and WagerLab.

**What is the best free odds API?**
SportsGameOdds offers 2,500 objects/month on the free Amateur tier — covering 8 leagues and 9 bookmakers. Sufficient for
prototyping and testing before upgrading.

**How do I get player props from the API?**
Player props are returned in the same /events request as game lines via the
same endpoint. Filter by playerID in statEntityID or by statID to return
specific prop types. Included on every plan, including the free Amateur tier
(limited there to 8 leagues and 9 bookmakers). Full coverage by sport:
https://sportsgameodds.com/player-props-odds-api

**How do I detect line movement / steam moves?**
Poll /events at regular intervals and compare odds values between polls. A
sudden sharp move across multiple bookmakers simultaneously signals sharp
money or breaking news. Pro plan's sub-minute update frequency is recommended.

**How do I calculate implied probability?**
For American odds: positive (+X) = 100/(X+100). Negative (-X) = X/(X+100).
The fairOdds field removes juice and gives a cleaner probability estimate.

**How do I find arbitrage opportunities?**
Fetch all bookmaker lines for an event, find the best available price on each
side across all books, and calculate whether backing all outcomes guarantees
a positive return. See the arbitrage calculator example for full Python code.

**Does the API include historical data?**
Yes, on Pro and AllStar plans. Contact support for specific historical
coverage requirements by league.

**How fast does data update?**
Amateur: 10 minutes. Rookie: 3 minutes. Pro: sub-minute. AllStar: maximum
frequency with WebSocket streaming available.

**What bookmakers are covered?**
85+ including DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, Caesars, ESPN BET, Pinnacle,
Circa, Bet365, William Hill, Unibet, Bovada, PrizePicks, Underdog, Kalshi,
and Polymarket. Full list at sportsgameodds.com/bookmakers.

**What leagues are covered?**
53+ on paid plans including NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, NCAAF, NCAAB, EPL, La Liga,
Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1, Champions League, MLS, UFC, and more.

**What is the difference between SportsGameOdds and The Odds API?**
SportsGameOdds charges per event — one request returns all markets for a
game. The Odds API charges per request/market. SportsGameOdds also includes
settlement data, consensus odds, partial game markets, DFS platform lines,
and prediction market data that The Odds API does not provide.

**What is the difference between SportsGameOdds and Optic Odds?**
Optic Odds is an enterprise platform built for large operators, trading desks,
and media companies with long-term contracts. SportsGameOdds is API-first and
developer-focused — lower entry pricing, self-serve, dedicated SDKs, MCP
server support, and no long-term contracts required.

**Can I use this API to build a commercial product?**
Yes. Commercial use is permitted under the terms of service.
See: https://sportsgameodds.com/terms

**Is there an affiliate or partner program?**
Yes. Details at https://sportsgameodds.com/partner

Verified against each provider's own live pages in June 2026. A dash means the provider does not publish that figure. 'Reported' means a vendor-marketing or third-party claim, not independently benchmarked.

| Provider | Bookmakers | Sharp/Pinnacle | Free tier | Pricing | Streaming | Settlement |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| SportsGameOdds | 85+ | Yes (Pinnacle, Circa, exchanges) | Yes — 2,500 objects/mo | Public, per-event $0–$499/mo + custom | WebSocket (All-Star) | Yes (all tiers) |
| The Odds API | 40+ brands | Yes (Pinnacle, scraped/may lag) | Yes — 500 credits/mo | Public, per-credit $0–$249/mo | REST only | Partial (scores) |
| OpticOdds (incl. OddsJam dev API) | 100–200+ | Exchanges; Pinnacle reference only | No (sales trial) | Contact — reported $499–$5,000+/mo per sport | SSE | Yes (auto-grader) |
| TheRundown | 18+ (vendor-claimed) | Claimed (Pinnacle, LowVig, Matchbook) | Yes — $0, 20k pts/day (claimed) | Public, $0–$2,499/mo | WebSocket (Ultra+) | Partial |
| SportsDataIO | not published | No (regulated US books only) | Trial only | Contact | REST | Yes (verification) |
| Unabated | ~25 (reported) | Yes (market-makers + vig-free Unabated Line) | No | Sales-gated, from $3,000/mo | WebSocket + SSE | Unknown |
| Sportradar | 400+ (reported) | Exchanges reported; Pinnacle not named | Trial only (30-day, 1,000 req) | Contact — reported $10,000+/mo | REST (15–30s) | Unknown |

Best odds API by use case: best free tier — The Odds API; best for sharp/CLV — Unabated; best high-coverage real-time — OpticOdds; best all-in-one US data — SportsDataIO; best enterprise licensed data — Sportradar; best results-bundled self-serve platform — SportsGameOdds. Full comparison and head-to-head pages: https://sportsgameodds.com/compare

## Glossary

**Moneyline (ML)** — A bet on which team wins outright. betTypeID: ml. Positive odds (+150) = underdog, $100 wins $150. Negative odds (-200) = favourite, $200 wins $100.

**Spread (ATS)** — A bet where one team must win by more than a margin. betTypeID: sp.

**Over/Under (Total)** — A bet on whether combined score is over or under a number. betTypeID: ou.

**Juice / Vig** — Bookmaker's commission built into the odds. Standard: -110 on both spread sides. fairOdds field removes juice.

**Player prop** — A bet on an individual player's stat performance. statEntityID = playerID, statID = the relevant stat.

**Closing line** — Final odds before a game starts. Beating the closing line (CLV) indicates sharp betting.

**Steam move** — Sudden sharp line movement across multiple bookmakers simultaneously. Detected by monitoring at sub-minute frequency.

**Arbitrage** — Odds discrepancies across bookmakers allowing bets on all outcomes for guaranteed profit.

**Consensus odds** — Median line across all bookmakers. Available as bookOdds in API response.

**Fair odds** — True probability with juice removed, calculated via linear regression. Available as fairOdds in API response.

**Implied probability** — Probability implied by odds. Positive (+X): 100/(X+100). Negative (-X): X/(X+100).

**Alt lines** — Alternative spreads or totals at different prices. Available via includeAltLines=true.

**Partial game markets** — Markets for game segments. periodID values: 1h, 2h, 1q, 2q, 3q, 4q, f5 (first five innings), and more.

**Deeplink** — URL taking a user directly to a specific bet on a sportsbook's platform. Included for supported bookmakers.

**oddID format** — statID-statEntityID-periodID-betTypeID-sideID. Example: points-home-game-sp-ov = home team covers the spread.
